rationale.usefulness: Tells an operator what a goal buys: agents leave the goal ~6x less often per call (holding), as well as joining ~5x more often; latent on-goal stints of ~80 calls; a dynamics-based calibration of H105's classifier (q1 0.67, q0 0.045).

one_line: An assigned goal is a symmetric field on a telegraph goal spin: kickoffs raise k_on and lower k_off (Delta ln k_off < 0 in 15/17 kickoffs; #12 debates the same), so HH367's 'k_on only' fails; dwell shape is not identifiable.

models.note: q = 2 kinetic goal spin (telegraph HMM) fits and recovers rates; its shape signatures are not identifiable
Field enters both rates as in Glauber kinetics (symmetric), not as an attempt rate
